key: Read LH and FSH first: high values mean the gonads failed (hypergonadotropic); low values mean GnRH or the pituitary is quiet, either temporarily with a delayed bone age and family history (constitutional delay) or from a real defect (hypogonadotropic).
items: Father had his growth spurt at 16
A late-maturing parent is the classic clue, because the timing of puberty is strongly inherited.
Bone age 2 years behind, LH fitting the bone age
The whole clock runs late, so gonadotropins are appropriate for the skeletal age rather than truly deficient.
Steady growth along a low percentile
Growth velocity is normal for bone age, unlike the falling velocity of a hormone deficiency.
Puberty starts on its own without treatment
The axis is healthy but late, so puberty eventually begins without treatment.
Kallmann syndrome links failed GnRH neuron migration with olfactory failure and midline defects.
Low body fat lowers leptin, which suppresses GnRH pulses until energy balance improves.
Energy deficit causes a reversible, functional suppression of hypothalamic GnRH secretion.
A sellar mass compresses the pituitary and stalk, lowering LH and FSH along with other pituitary hormones.
Turner syndrome ovaries fail, so the pituitary raises FSH and LH against absent estrogen feedback.
Klinefelter testes fail at the tubules and Leydig cells, so FSH and LH climb.
Radiation destroys oocytes or germ cells directly, a gonadal failure with high gonadotropins.
FSH markedly raised with low estradiol
High FSH against low sex steroids shows the pituitary is working and the gonad is not.
